title: Auth guard REST-compatibility route contracts
observed_behavior: /settings with an insufficient route role did not render the permission-denied state.
/orgs rendered without the REST compatibility guard when direct_nostr_http_auth was unavailable, allowing org REST requests.
intended_behavior: Protected routes fail closed under signer-first authentication.
Routes that still depend on REST compatibility render an explicit compatibility-required state when direct_nostr_http_auth is unavailable and do not mount child pages that issue REST requests.
Route contracts are represented in route-access metadata rather than hardcoded production auth state.
